# Euler Problem 8 Solution in C++

## Problem Statement
Find the greatest product of five consecutive digits in the 1000-digit number.

## Solution

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long largestProduct(const string& digits, int consecutive) {
    long long maxProduct = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= (int)digits.length() - consecutive; i++) {
        long long product = 1;
        bool hasZero = false;
        
        // Calculate product of consecutive digits
        for (int j = 0; j < consecutive; j++) {
            int digit = digits[i + j] - '0';
            if (digit == 0) {
                hasZero = true;
                break;
            }
            product *= digit;
        }
        
        // Only consider products without zeros
        if (!hasZero) {
            maxProduct = max(maxProduct, product);
        }
    }
    
    return maxProduct;
}
